title: NEONAILSonax Premium No Wipe Crystal Top Coat 15ml | Ultra-Shiny, Long-Lasting Clear Gel | Soak-Off UV/LED Gel Nail Polish | Chip-Resistant, Quick-Dry, Professional Nail Art Finish for Salon & DIY Use
description: NEONAIL Sonax Crystal Top Coat is your go-to solution for a high-shine, long-lasting finish that guarantees perfect nails every time. With a generous 15ml (0.51 fl oz) bottle, this no-wipe top coat is designed to give your nails a beautiful, glossy, crystal-clear shine that lasts for 21+ days, making it ideal for both home DIY manicures and professional nail salons. The flexible formula resists nicks, chips, and smudges, ensuring your nails stay flawless throughout the wear. The smooth and easy application is perfect for both beginners and seasoned nail artists alike. Whether you are doing your nails at home or in a salon, this top coat is easy to apply, dries quickly, and doesn’t require wiping, saving you time and effort. It ensures an even, streak-free finish with every application. The quick-drying formula needs only 60-120 seconds under a UV lamp to completely set, so you can continue with your routine without long waits. NEONAIL’s improved formula contains 9 toxin-free ingredients, making it gentle on your nails and healthy for your skin. The low-odor formula ensures a pleasant experience while applying. For ultimate protection and shine, this top coat is perfect for nail art enthusiasts, offering both long-lasting durability and a crystal-clear finish. It also prevents fading and yellowing, so your nails stay vibrant and fresh for weeks. Achieve salon-quality results at home with NEONAIL's Sonax Crystal Top Coat.
